objective.loss: Causal next-token cross entropy for targets at stream positions 1..T-1
objective.target_index_rule: For window starting at absolute stream offset o, x_i=stream[o+i] and y_i=stream[o+i+1], i=0..min(1023,T-2-o).
objective.window_offsets: 0,1024,2048,... in monotonically increasing source-stream order; one pass; no resampling or block shuffling.
objective.eos_cross_document_attention_policy: EOS_DELIMITER_ONLY_NO_ATTENTION_RESET. Within a 1024-token window, tokens after EOS may attend tokens before EOS. This is a pretraining-stream approximation, not a source-conditioned instruction objective.
objective.eos_to_next_document_target: Included as standard next-token target when the next document begins within a window. This synthetic boundary task is acknowledged, not mislabeled as same-document prediction.
objective.final_window: Short input/target pair padded to 1024 for tensor shape only, pad positions fully excluded from loss.
objective.data_exposure_claim: 100M train tokens in the immutable stream; 99,999,999 loss target positions, not exactly 100M non-padding predictions.

batch_optimizer.gradient_reduction: Sum nonpadding token losses and normalize by number of supervised target positions actually accumulated in the optimizer step.
batch_optimizer.lr_schedule: Frozen S0/S1/S2/S3 LRs and warmup/cosine in slm_training_regime_preseal.json
batch_optimizer.update_semantics: One AdamW optimizer update per full or final partial effective batch; no hidden extra epochs.
batch_optimizer.precision: Record actual device, dtype and loss scaling. Any architecture-specific precision downgrade limits capacity-only comparability.

interpretation.capacity_lr_covariation: Frozen S0..S3 peak LRs differ; performance differences are between preregistered architecture-plus-optimizer configurations, not the isolated causal effect of parameter count.
interpretation.data_starvation: Token-per-parameter exposure declines strongly across S0..S3; report ratios, do not treat higher capacity undertraining as evidence of a universal ability ceiling.
interpretation.no_rewrite_supervision: Natural next-token data contain zero observed <src>, <ctx>, <cand> control tokens. The PIA source-conditioned route is a separate zero-shot instrument probe, not an already learned rewriting objective.

checks_required_before_training: Assert exact token bytes/hashes and target-position accounting.
Verify EOS boundary behavior on synthetic 1024+ token fixture.
Verify final partial optimizer step performs nonpadding-token-normalized loss.
Verify EOS special token and PAD excluded only as specified.
Verify S0..S3 topology and exact parameter counts.
Record hardware, precision and provenance receipt without performance-based tuning.
